narrative: On the board. The third sheet, the glass not yet in the margin. Two sheets lie face up beside it. On the board. Three short lines at the side of the speech, written smaller than the verse. The sheet is half full. The pen is still in the hand. Three sheets on the board. The Holinshed is still shut. The chair is where it was at first light.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the glass in three beats and stopped.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in Sent for, looked in, broken
